notes.title: Splat the Blob Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are proud to announce that we have fixed a large bug concerning the inability to consistently cause Splat to jump. If you were unable to get Splat to consistently jump, please download the latest update and give the game another try.

Thank you for playing!
Simple-Blue
